"Since the world found peace,
  I come here whenever I have time.
  I've run out of places to lay flowers.

"With the evil lord defeated...
  I'm thinking of rebuilding
  the Kingdom of Dundrasil.

"It'll take time and many hands, but when
  it's done, I'll give you two a
  more splendid grave!

"Ha ha, how pathetic of me.
  I always weep when I come here.
  Growing old is no fun.

"What is it, {var:1}?
  Come now, let's go.
